verdict.rationale: xAI documents custom function calling with the agent-loop pattern: the model requests a call, you execute it locally, and you return the result. The grok-4.7 spec card lists "Function calling: Yes," and the OpenAI-compatible REST API plus built-in and remote MCP tools support multi-step agentic use. missing for 10: explicit evidence of parallel tool calls, documented typed/JSON-schema tool parameter definitions (only implied via structured outputs), and independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.
